name: Progression - Start Date Update on Unapproved Episode (Gap Story)
description: ZSC00001 completed and approved. A PUT adds ZSC00002 (unapproved, startDate 2026-02-01, expectedEndDate 2027-01-31). A second PUT changes ZSC00002's startDate to 2026-03-01. Documents the known gap: StartDate changes on unapproved episodes are not forwarded to Earnings. The ThirtyPercent instalment for ZSC00002 should update to delivery period 11 (estimated 30% point for a Mar 2026 start, landing in Jun 2026) but currently stays at period 10 (May 2026, the original Feb start). Assertion expects 11 and will fail until the gap is fixed.

steps.name: SLD PUTs ZSC00001 (completed) + ZSC00002 (new, startDate 2026-02-01) — Progression
Verify ZSC00002 unapproved earnings profile created with period 7 ThirtyPercent instalment, then press Enter to send start date update
SLD PUTs ZSC00001 (completed) + ZSC00002 with updated startDate 2026-03-01 — date change not forwarded to Earnings

assertions.name: ZSC00002 ThirtyPercent instalment updated to delivery period 11 (estimated 30% point for Mar 2026 start — currently FAILS at 10 because StartDate changes are not forwarded to Earnings)
